title: There comes a time in a boy's life when they are tempted to abandon their youth and become a mature man who no longer plays with toy soldiers. I sit and learn about a disease 25% of will get by the time we're 60. And I wonder, will I be able to run 50 Wyches with progressive osteoarthritis of the knee? With a total knee arthroplasty? Will I be able to play, or merely paint my models far above the standard I am satisfied with, wishing that I could throw those pieces of art on the floor back like I did in my 20s? And that is when I realize that I am not one to give up playing with toy soldiers merely for a nebulous concept of social maturity. I will twirl my nonexistent mustache and laugh at the absurdity of the best faction in 40k, and relish in the boyhood it represents. (2000 points)
